visual.general_description: Two stacked scatter plots (a and b) of percent hepatic adenoma reduction against percent BMI decrease and percent excess weight loss, each with a blue fitted line, gray confidence band and printed Kendall's Tau-b and p value.
visual.detailed_description: Scatter plot "a" has a white background with faint dashed grid lines and a left/bottom axis frame. Green dots: three at x=0 (y about 8.8, 4.6 and 4.0); one at x of about 51 (y about 24); two near x of about 56-57 (y about 13 and 11.7); four at x=100 (y about 17, 14.3, 14.0 and 11.5). The blue Kendall-Theil-Sen line goes from about (0, 7.4) to about (100, 14.5). The gray band is widest at the left (about 1.7 to 14 at x=0) and narrows toward the right (about 10.5 to 21 at x=100). Point values are estimates from the plot; no per-point labels or patient identifiers are printed. Scatter plot "b" has the same style as panel a. Green dots: three near x=0 (y about 57, 29 and 10.5); one at x of about 51 (y about 96); one near x of about 56 (y about 81); one near x of about 57 (y about 60); three at x=100 (y about 100, 78 and 70). The blue line runs from about (0, 46) to about (100, 89); the gray band extends from about 14 to 63 at x=0 and about 70 to 113 at x=100. Only nine dots are distinguishable although panel a shows ten, so a point may overlap or lie outside the visible area. Values are estimates from the plot; no per-point labels or patient identifiers are printed.
